final: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) as cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM riskandmargin ram INNER JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp) as share, COUNT(*) * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u2.acctscope) FROM users u2) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM riskandmargin ram INNER JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp) as count_div_avg FROM riskandmargin ram INNER JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope ORDER BY u.acctscope
